run_gtest_help_test: run the gtest help test suite to verify help flag behavior for Google C++ Testing Framework
test_RunWithFlag: test the RunWithFlag function to run gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_GTestHelpTest_TestHelpFlag: test the GTestHelpTest TestHelpFlag method to verify help message is printed and tests are skipped when a help flag is specified
test_GTestHelpTest_TestNonHelpFlag: test the GTestHelpTest TestNonHelpFlag method to verify tests run normally and no help message is printed without a help flag
review_GTestHelpTest: review the GTestHelpTest class and its test methods for verifying help flag variants like --help, -h, -?, and /?
